name: scaffoldev
description: Build a complete website from a short prompt (company profile, landing page, portfolio, small-business catalog, or dashboard), with every design decision recorded and every page checked.

interface.shortDescription: A short prompt in, a checked website out
interface.longDescription: Turns a short prompt into a finished static website. Every design decision is recorded with its reason, every page is linted and audited, and EXPLAIN.html shows who decided what. Guided mode teaches; deep mode lets a council of AI roles deliberate.
defaultPrompt: buat company profile Kopi Senja, kedai kopi di Bandung, target mahasiswa
